contract.input_model: The libFuzzer byte stream should be decoded as zero or more mini_parser command frames. Keep one mp_context alive across all frames in one LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput call.

context.lifetime: one context per libFuzzer iteration, initialized before the command loop and destroyed after the loop

command_loop.selector: consume one fuzzer byte per step and map it to opcode range 1..7
command_loop.payload_length_source: consume one or more fuzzer bytes per step, cap to MP_MAX_PAYLOAD and remaining bytes

requirements: Use a bounded multi-frame command loop, not a single raw pass-through call.
Repair the outer frame envelope but preserve fuzzer-controlled payload and nested payload fields.
Set both bytes of the little-endian payload length at offsets 4 and 5.
Set both bytes of the little-endian checksum at offsets 6 and 7 using mp_checksum.
Call mp_parse(&ctx, frame, MP_HEADER_SIZE + payload_length) for each complete frame.
Call mp_destroy(&ctx) exactly once after the loop.
notes: Valid envelopes improve coverage and feature discovery because mp_parse rejects malformed magic, version, length and checksum before reaching opcode-specific logic.
Stateful opcodes MP_STORE, MP_RELEASE and MP_USE need a context that lives across multiple frames in one fuzz input.
